chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Abdullah ibn al-Mughira, from Abdullah ibn Sinan, from Abdullah ibn Sinan, who said:

I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about a man who was in the Obligatory Tawaaf, so the Prayer was established. He (peace be upon him) said: 'He should pray the Obligatory [Prayer] with them. So when he is free, he can build [complete his prayer] from where he had cut it [stopped].'

key_terms.يُبْنِي: To build/complete (in the context of prayer or ritual)

ai.seo_question: What should a person do if the prayer time comes while they are performing Tawaaf?
ai.summary: This ruling from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) highlights the jurisprudential principle of prioritizing the congregational prayer (Salat al-Jama'ah) over the continuity of Tawaaf, reflecting the Shafi'i and Ja'fari schools' view that the obligation of prayer takes precedence. It establishes that the Tawaaf is not invalidated by the interruption, allowing the worshipper to resume from the exact point of departure, thereby balancing the spiritual benefits of both acts of worship.
